data.exact_reserve_text: There were no issues arising from our closed years being 2007 to 2011 and all of these years combined produced a surplus which contributed both to the calendar year result and the closing 2012 account result. A long running disputed claim,which affected the 2011 underwriting year,was settled in July producing a satisfactory reserve release.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Settled in July producing a satisfactory reserve release

named_events.loss_description: Mentioned as having caused small prior rate increases in affected areas

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports favourable development on its closed years (2007-2011) which produced an overall surplus contributing to results; specifically a long-running disputed claim affecting the 2011 underwriting year was settled in July, producing a satisfactory reserve release. No gross prior-year reserve movement amount is quantified in the accounts or notes.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure is provided in the notes or narrative. The report contains narrative references to surplus/releases on closed years (2007-2011) and settlement of a disputed 2011 claim, but no quantified gross prior-year development. A claims development table is present only as gross loss ratios (percentages) and per-underwriting-year gross written premiums by year are not provided to convert that table into an absolute gross PYD. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null.
